Six number tokens are given. Rearrange them to form a 6-digit number such that:
• The difference between the first and last digits is as small as possible
• The hundreds digit is double the thousands digit
• No consecutive digits appear next to each other
• All given tokens must be used exactly once
How many different 6-digit numbers between 2 lakhs and 8 lakhs can be formed under these conditions?
a) 1
b) 2
c) 3
d) More than 3
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Starter
decide how to begin
Begin with the hundreds and thousands places. Which pairs of tokens have one digit double the other?
Slicer
break it into small parts
For each pair, choose the first and last digits, then fill the rest. Cross out any number with neighbours like 4 and 5.
YOUR TURN
Keep only the numbers between 2,00,000 and 8,00,000.
